correctness.rationale: Coprime positive legs supported on {2,3} must be 2^alpha and 3^beta; factoring (z-3^beta)(z+3^beta)=2^(2alpha) with gcd 2 and checking residues modulo8 forces (alpha,beta)=(2,1): the unique primitive pair {3,4}. Scaling gives edges in the exponent rectangle precisely (a,b) to (a+2,b-1). Weight w=a+2b separates disjoint path components with L_w consecutive vertices, and max independent sets have size ceil(L_w/2) and count (L_w/2+1) for positive even lengths or 1 for odd lengths. The four N modulo4 formulas follow from counting odd-length components. Independent exact-square tests on 49 rectangles A,B<=7 reproduced all graph edges; brute enumeration of all subsets when AB<=16 matched maxima and multiplicities. No claim for more prime coordinates.
